name: Envision
headline: Compliance intelligence. Fewer blind spots.
description: Envision is a next-generation compliance monitoring tool designed to connect obligations, accountable owners and supporting evidence in one workspace. Turn scattered calendars and follow-ups into a structured compliance process, with a clearer view of what is due, what is complete and what needs attention.
features: Central register of regulatory and internal obligations
Owner assignment, due-date reminders and escalation
Evidence collection, review and exception tracking
Management dashboards for compliance visibility
outcome: Make compliance easier to monitor, demonstrate and improve.

name: Approve-X
headline: Move decisions forward. Keep accountability in view.
description: Approve-X brings workflow intelligence to approval management. Replace disconnected emails and manual chasing with structured request routing, defined authority and a traceable decision history, helping teams move work forward with the right oversight.
features: Configurable approval paths and delegation of authority
Request validation and supporting-document capture
Reminders, escalations and delegated approvals
Decision histories and turnaround visibility
outcome: Give every request a clear route from submission to decision.

name: Capex IQ
headline: Asset intelligence across the lifecycle.
description: Capex IQ is a fixed asset management tool designed to bring clarity to what your business owns, where assets are located and who is responsible for them. Connect asset records, movements and verification with the broader capital investment journey for stronger stewardship and reporting.
features: Central asset register with classification and ownership
Acquisition, capitalization and movement records
Physical verification and reconciliation workflows
Lifecycle visibility from allocation to disposal
outcome: Turn fragmented asset records into a dependable operating view.

name: AuditIQ
headline: Next-generation audit management. From risk to resolution.
description: AuditIQ connects the internal audit lifecycle in a collaborative workspace. Bring audit planning, fieldwork, evidence and action tracking together so teams can spend less time coordinating files and more time examining the risks and findings that matter.
features: Risk-based audit universe and engagement planning
Fieldwork programs, workpapers and evidence management
Observation review and management responses
Action ownership, follow-up and closure reporting
outcome: Build a connected audit trail from the first test to final closure.

name: ControlIQ
headline: Control assurance, connected to the evidence.
description: ControlIQ is a SOX and internal financial controls testing platform designed to connect risks, controls, test procedures and evidence. Coordinate testing cycles, review deficiencies and track remediation with clear ownership across finance, process and assurance teams.
features: Risk and control matrices with process-owner mapping
Design and operating-effectiveness testing workflows
Evidence requests, reviewer sign-off and audit trails
Deficiency assessment and remediation tracking
outcome: Bring consistency and accountability to every control-testing cycle.

name: Workflow Automation Solution
headline: Less repetitive work. More room for meaningful work.
description: Connect the manual steps that slow your teams down. Our workflow automation solutions are designed around your business processes, bringing forms, task routing, approvals and system handoffs into a coordinated flow with human review where it matters.
features: Process discovery and automation opportunity mapping
Digital forms, task routing and approval workflows
System integrations and exception handling
Operational dashboards and continuous improvement
outcome: Create repeatable, visible workflows that help people work smarter.

name: Plinari
headline: From ERP data to a finance function that moves with your business.
description: Connect planning, treasury, closure and reporting on one validated data model. Plinari turns ERP data into working finance intelligence, helping teams reconcile continuously, model decisions and answer business questions with current numbers.
features: Dynamic operating plans and budget simulations
Treasury, liquidity and accelerated financial closure
Continuous reconciliation and FIFO-based gross-margin P&L
Automated MIS and chat-based finance collaboration
graphicLabel: ERP data flows through validation into a shared finance model for planning, treasury and closure.

name: EDI
headline: Move from reviewing yesterday to deciding what comes next.
description: Give leadership a shared view of performance with consistent KPIs, drill-downs and scenario modelling. EDI connects business data with conversational, cited answers so leaders can explore a variance, compare options and act with context.
features: Consistent KPIs and connected C-suite dashboards
What-if simulations with business-unit drill-downs
Natural-language questions with cited answers
Variance alerts and mobile access for leadership
graphicLabel: An illustrative scenario comparison shows baseline, growth and pressure paths to support leadership decisions.

name: CCM
headline: See control gaps sooner. Put remediation in motion.
description: Replace periodic, sample-based reviews with ongoing monitoring across leases, billing, payments, approvals and compliance. Connect exceptions to supporting evidence and accountable owners, helping teams move from detecting issues to preventing recurrence.
features: Anomaly detection and process-workflow validation
Evidence capture with a traceable audit history
Owned remediation workflows and policy obligations
Predictive risk views with ERP and property-system integration
graphicLabel: A conceptual controls monitor connects transaction checks, flagged exceptions, evidence and remediation owners.

name: REIQ
headline: One connected operating layer for the real estate lifecycle.
description: Bring contracts, sales, project operations, customer relationships, receivables and leasing into a connected AI-enabled ecosystem. REIQ modules can work independently or together, coordinating work across teams and the property lifecycle.
features: Contract and lease lifecycle management
AI-enabled sales and omnichannel customer journeys
Project coordination across teams, vendors and sites
ERP-connected receivables and governed collections
graphicLabel: A real estate module map connects contracts, sales, projects, CRM, receivables and leasing through REIQ.

name: VayamIQ
headline: A more structured hiring journey, from role brief to offer.
description: Connect recruiters and candidates through one auditable workflow. VayamIQ brings together competency-led job descriptions, AI-assisted shortlisting, assessments, interviews and reusable background verification to support better-informed hiring decisions.
features: Competency-mapped job descriptions and CV scoring
Psychometric and technical assessments with interview scheduling
Reusable, verified background-check records
Digital offers, self-service portals and hiring-funnel visibility
graphicLabel: A recruitment funnel progresses from role definition through shortlisting, assessment, verification and offer.

name: The Convex
headline: Help your brand get found, cited and represented accurately in AI answers.
description: Understand how AI answer engines describe your brand and which sources shape their responses. The Convex connects visibility and competitor tracking with structured knowledge, content improvements and misrepresentation alerts to strengthen your presence in AI-led discovery.
features: Multi-engine visibility and prompt-level share of voice
Citation attribution and competitor answer mapping
Schema, entity and knowledge-graph improvements
AI-ready content, misrepresentation alerts and executive reporting
graphicLabel: Verified brand sources feed structured knowledge and AI answers, with a feedback loop for citation and accuracy monitoring.
